key_insight: VISTA Architect turns raw longitudinal EHRs into a provenance-linked graph plus a concise clinical timeline, so LLMs can answer patient-history questions faster and more accurately.
clinical_relevance: In tumor boards, it helps clinicians reconstruct complex oncology histories with less manual chart review while preserving links back to source documentation for verification.
method: Builds a source-faithful MEDS Graph from clinical records with full provenance.
Creates a Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) that uses graph-guided LLM extraction to deduplicate and order key events.
Supports downstream queries on the precomputed patient state, with optional trace-back to original notes.
evidence_signal: Across 1,180 patients and 17,700 evaluations of 15 tumor-board variables, the system reached 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10), outperforming a matched BM25 RAG baseline.
watch_item: Results were demonstrated in thoracic oncology only, so broader performance and workflow fit still need validation in other specialties.
paper_title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
